sources.title: GitHub - punithkrishnakeepudi/cattle-breed-classifier
sources.snippet: Cattle Breed Classifier is a production-ready full-stack machine learning application that automatically identifies 50 Indian cattle breeds from photographs with 80% accuracy. The system uses advanced deep learning techniques and provides explainable AI (XAI) visualizations to show why the model made each prediction.
